title: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat

scheme.name: PMMSY: Motorcycle with Ice Box - Gujarat
scheme.summary: The scheme provides financial support to fishermen and related beneficiaries for a motorcycle with an ice box to modernize cold chain infrastructure and ensure hygienic fish storage.
eligibility: The applicant should be a native of Gujarat state.
The applicant should have a fishing boat registered under Real Craft software.
The applicant should hold a fishing license.
The applicant should complete the online registration on the iKhedut Portal.
The applicant should obtain in-principle approval before purchase of the floor plan.
The applicant should have his/her own bank account.
scheme.benefits: General category beneficiaries receive 40% assistance up to ₹30,000/- while women and ST/SC beneficiaries receive 60% assistance up to ₹45,000/- out of the total unit cost of ₹75,000/-.
scheme.how_to_apply: Applicants can apply online through the I-Khedut Portal by registering, selecting the agricultural scheme, applying, and submitting the form.

summary.quote: The scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with the component of "Motorcycle with Ice Box", introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Co-operation Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to modernise cold chain infrastructure to preserve fish health, uplift fishermen, and enhance value chain efficiency.
